topics.name: Repository Acceptance Validation
topics.purpose: Define final acceptance criteria for the clean Contract Format 1.4 repository tree by composing format, identity/reference, Topic, structure/ownership, behavior/causality, graph closure and migration validation into one machine-readable result.

semantics.aggregation_rule: Acceptance result retains each dimension separately; one passing score cannot hide another failing dimension.
semantics.whole_tree_rule: Acceptance is computed over the complete candidate active tree, not only changed files.
semantics.migration_rule: Retained legacy semantics are mapped, intentionally retired, or explicitly unresolved.
semantics.outsider_rule: Remaining outsiders are visible and evaluated against lock/replacement policy.
semantics.replacement_rule: Only accepted candidate tree is eligible for explicit clean-tree replacement approval.
semantics.evidence_rule: Acceptance emits machine-readable evidence refs suitable for repository-level lock state.

invariants.rule: Validation proves or rejects conformance; it never invents missing semantics or becomes semantic owner.

hard_gates.condition: failing validation dimension hidden by aggregate pass
only changed files validated for final acceptance
migration coverage incomplete but candidate accepted
repository locked without current acceptance evidence
